description: Rows for two schema files outside O-A's first write boundary, proposed at E-1 and APPLIED in those files by O-A under R23-18 (run APP-V4-DESIGN-PASS-4-20261003). PR-5 is applied with the same meaning written in anyOf/const/enum/false, the keyword subset EXEC's own checker reads (EXEC schema 0.7). run_e.py part A checks that each row is present. Each row adds; none removes, narrows or relaxes an existing constraint.

files.EXEC: projects/chirality-app-v4/execution/PKG-02_Workflow and role portability/1_Working/DEL-02-03_Workflow execution compatibility and round-trip support/Design/checkpoint-record-entries.schema.json
files.AAC_OFFER: projects/chirality-app-v4/execution/PKG-01_Native App and third-party harness integration/1_Working/DEL-01-04_Native requests, outcomes and attachments/Design/aac.offer.schema.json
files.AAC_CAPTURE: projects/chirality-app-v4/execution/PKG-01_Native App and third-party harness integration/1_Working/DEL-01-04_Native requests, outcomes and attachments/Design/aac.capture-evidence.schema.json

rows.why: A package may name A16 decide (ACT §2.1 A16 row; R23-8 item 3).
How a package is identified: a file the agent writes, observed by the App writer, never message text (EXEC RC-5; RS §13.6).

rows.name: alternatives

value.description: Decision package (V4-PM-04; R23-8): the alternatives, two or more, each with an identity unique within the package and a statement.

rows.why: R23-8 item 1: the first added element.

rows.name: consequences

value.description: Decision package (V4-PM-04; R23-8): the stated consequences, each tied to one alternative by its identity.

rows.why: R23-8 item 1: the second added element.

value.description: A decision package file carries alternatives and consequences; alternatives and consequences appear only on a package (R23-8).

rows.why: Keeps the two elements to packages and makes them required there.
An A16 whose package changes is lapse-evaluated (RS §7 L-1, L-6; DECISION_VIEW DV-7); the act_lapsed body (CE-10) cites the act through actRef, whose kind list lacks A16.

rows.name: alternatives

value.description: A16 (R23-8): the package's alternatives as shown, each with its consequences.

rows.why: The person sees the alternatives and consequences in the control (V4-PM-04).

value.description: A16 (R23-8): one package as subject, its request, its alternatives; wording 'decide'; no decline. Alternatives belong to A16 only.

rows.why: Same pattern as the A4/A6/A7 and A15 rules beside it.

rows.name: alternativeChosen

value.description: A16 (R23-8): the identity of the alternative the person chose.

rows.why: The capture holds what the person chose; RS's A16 record cites it.

value.description: A16 (R23-8) names its request and the alternative chosen; alternativeChosen is A16's only.

rows.why: Same pattern as the A15 rules beside it.
